notes.title: Notice of Price Change
notes.notes:
We at 24Frame, INC. have decided to change the price of "SURVIRUS" to free.

The price change is scheduled to be implemented on February 29, 2024.

"SURVIRUS" is one of the projects prototyped within 24Frame, INC. with the aim of accumulating technical expertise and knowledge. This decision was made to allow users to more easily enjoy games developed in such an experimental manner.

We look forward to your continued support for "SURVIRUS" and 24Frame, INC.
